race.description: Windsor Hotel Country Cup Challenge Qualifier Hcp
race.comment: TOUCH OF GRACIE (11) is the top pick off a useful set-up change, with weight relief, a return to 1400m and the Corey & Kylie Geran stable's strong Dalby record helping offset a plain Toowoomba eighth over 1650m. Her Warra second to Linwar two runs back keeps her right in this. LONERGY (9) is poised to win after placing at his last three outings, most recently when second over 1350m at Eidsvold. Has the talent to find the winners' list. CARDIOLOGIST (5) was dominant as a well-supported favourite at Charleville and brings reliable track and distance credentials into the harder assignment. GRINZINGER KNIGHT (1) produced a reasonable effort when third last start over 1350m at Eidsvold. That followed a win at Nanango the start prior. Likely improver with top-three prospects. SPOOKY SPIRIT (7) is third-up and eased from BM70 company after a better Gold Coast Poly fourth. In the mix.
